packageRules.description: mise's own manager looks clang up as a conda package and fails; the regex manager below tracks it as LLVM's release
Flutter's Gradle plugin loader ships inside the Flutter SDK and is published to no repository; it moves with flutter

A runner image is a whole build environment (glibc, Visual Studio, Xcode): ubuntu-22.04 is the deliberate glibc floor of the Linux build and the snap job must match its core24 base, so an image change waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
The build jobs stay on mise 2026.6.11 until a newer release fixes the Windows shim regression (see publish.yml); approve on the Dependency Dashboard to try one

customManagers.description: mise's own manager cannot look clang up; it is LLVM's release
